analysis.stability: EDD is highly stable at T<=0.70 (8-9/9 cells at EDD=3). The major transition occurs between T=0.75 and T=0.80, where 2 additional cells drop from EDD=3, driven by d2v3 AUC values in the 0.75-0.80 marginal zone.
analysis.sensitivity_pattern: Sensitivity is concentrated in the topk50 decoding strategy (all 3 topk50 cells are among the 4 sensitive cells). The d2v3 pair (depth-2 vs depth-3) is the universal bottleneck — it determines EDD for all cells at all thresholds. The d0v1 pair (>0.98 everywhere) is never the limiting factor.
analysis.model_effect: GPT-2-XL is most robust (all 3 cells EDD>=2 at T=0.80, 2/3 at EDD=3). Pythia-1.4B is most sensitive (pythia_topk50 is the only cell to reach EDD=1). OLMo-1B falls in between.
analysis.strategy_effect: nucleus_p095 is most robust (3/3 EDD=3 at all thresholds). temperature_09 is slightly less robust (2/3 EDD=3 at T=0.80). topk50 is most sensitive (0/3 EDD=3 at T=0.80). This aligns with topk50's lower sampling diversity reducing inter-depth signal.
analysis.recommended_threshold: T=0.75. Rationale: (1) 7/9 cells maintain EDD=3, demonstrating the non-saturation finding is robust across most model-strategy combinations. (2) Only topk50 settings drop, which are known to produce the weakest inter-depth signals. (3) 0.75 is the conventional 'acceptable discrimination' threshold in AUC literature. (4) T=0.80 is too aggressive — it pushes 4 cells below EDD=3 due to marginal d2v3 values (0.75-0.80), inflating apparent sensitivity without meaningful signal loss. (5) T=0.65/0.70 are too lenient — they mask the genuine weakness of topk50.
analysis.key_insight: The core finding — recursive generation depth is distinguishable and signal does not saturate by depth 3 — is robust across a wide range of thresholds for 7/9 model-strategy cells. The 2 exceptions (pythia_topk50, olmo_topk50) reflect topk50's known tendency to flatten text distributions, not threshold sensitivity per se.

metadata.edd_definition: EDD = max depth d such that all consecutive AUC(d_i vs d_{i+1}) >= threshold for i=0..d-1. If all pairs pass, EDD = max_depth (3).
